newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Lion Brewery IPO opens to strong response.
newsitem.headline: Lion Brewery IPO opens to strong response.

text.p: The initial public offer (IPO) of Lion Brewery Ltd, which opened on the stock exchange on Thursday, was about 75 percent subscribed by noon, a company official told Reuters.
Lion Brewery, a subsidiary of Ceylon Brewery Ltd, announced an IPO of 12.5 million 10-rupee shares at 20 rupees.
"Over 9.5 million shares had been taken by noon today," said Suresh Shah, chief executive of both companies.
The company, however, will keep the offer open until Friday evening "to give the public every opportunity to respond", he said.
The new company is raising funds by issuing 50 million shares to build a plant with an initial installed capacity of 30 million litres per annum.

The Danish brewer Carlsberg, a stakeholder in Ceylon Brewery, has bought 24.6 percent of the issued capital in the new firm. Twenty-five percent is being issued to the public, and the remaining 50.4 percent has been taken by Ceylon Brewery.
The new plant, which is close to Colombo, was needed after beer sales rose sharply following a 70 percent cut in excise duty by the government in late 1995.
